title: Research note: sharp rational triangle recovery threshold (no new kappa)
body:
Rational vertex-star observations can recover a prescribed triangle in the paired-port graph, where the binary observations in woklerx's PR966 cannot. This research note proves the exact minimum nontarget deletion cost: 5 at p=3 and 6p-12 for every p>=4, over any field of characteristic other than two. It includes the exceptional K2,2 attachment and shows that its one-deletion saving requires all six raw vertex observations, versus three for an isolated triangle.

The change is confined to `research/rational-triangle-seed48/`. It adds a self-contained proof, exact certificate, standard-library checker, source pins and local sprint claim. The explicit dirty-helper echo costs 88 scalar primitives for the exceptional fixture and 42 for an isolated triangle, including source reads, half/double scales and full restoration. Direct target access costs only three ADDs in that alphabet. No scalar speedup, selected supplier, physical copy-rank improvement or new kappa is claimed.

Validation:

- Exhausted 840,693 seven-class assignments at p=3,4,5; minimum deletions 5,12,18.
- Separately checked all 512 retained p=3 graphs with exact rational row spaces, without the component reduction; 97 recoverable, three optimum graphs. Binary elimination admits none.
- Rejected all 35 single-edge restorations, 18 omitted raw observations and 172 individual instruction omissions; checked all 62 dirty/source/output basis columns of the three words.
- Normal and optimized CPython 3.14.8 pass on macOS arm64, including execution outside the checkout. Altered deletion, invoice and numeric-type receipts are rejected. Selected-record integrity and staged whitespace checks pass.

Reproduce from the repository root:

```sh
python3 -I -B research/rational-triangle-seed48/verify.py
```

Expected: `PASS_RATIONAL_TRIANGLE_S48 assignments=840693 graphs=512 deletions=5,12,18 restored_edges=35 omissions=172 no_new_kappa`.

Exact base: `dadfea6e8a78ff6ba901705f87532a71c6f5bbb8`; OS assignment seed 48, structural decoder track. PR966 predecessor head: `7eaf5665ac246310293fda06a3cf245fe72f6012`. Six local inputs are bound by SHA256 and Git blob IDs. The selected PR1094 conditional kappa remains `836330098538459/500000000000000000`.

A refreshed overlap check at 21:42 UTC covered 870 open PRs including drafts, 30 discussion records and 325 local records, with complete remote pagination and no access warnings. The specific signless/odd-cycle/rational-triangle search found only this local package. Broader searches identified PR966 and its binary audits; the changed observation field and exact triangle threshold are the additional evidence. No pinned coordination issue exists, so the donor's local-claim fallback was used. Search absence is not a novelty certificate.

Credit woklerx's PR966, Sam Sung / the-missionary-company's PR669, Joel Pulikkan / GamingPuzzled's PR231, and icekylinx/eumemic's paired-port lineage. Sagar Thakrar (@thakrarsagar) prepared this contribution with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in mathematics, implementation, verification and writing. Apache-2.0. No independent human review or literature-wide priority is claimed.

Review the changed-field recovery criterion, convex endpoint proof and distinction between raw observations and a paid gather. Rational observations and puncturing are changed contracts; physical geometry, precision, hosting and recursive supplier admission remain open. The full selected cold replay and hosted Linux checks were not run because no supplier or selected artifact changed. Open next questions are in the README.
